subject.title: fix(sqlite): stop mount probes blocking database startup

question: May SQLite database opening synchronously wait up to one second for mount classification on `/proc`-less hosts, or must classification be moved outside the database-open path?
rationale: The patch improves an existing unbounded wait, but accepting a bounded synchronous process probe establishes an availability and compatibility boundary that repository policy and tests alone cannot choose.

options.title: Remove startup process waits
options.body: Classify mounts asynchronously before database opening or reuse a lifecycle-owned cached classification, with conservative rollback when no classification is available.

options.title: Accept the bounded probe
options.body: Keep the one-second synchronous deadline only with explicit owner acceptance and real macOS/BSD proof of aggregate startup and journal-mode behavior.

recommendation.title: Remove startup process waits
recommendation.body: Classify mounts asynchronously before database opening or reuse a lifecycle-owned cached classification, with conservative rollback when no classification is available.
